src: shape template in section 1, component-count stencil in section 2, and two solid color swatches in sections 3-4
transform: crop the section-1 template to its non-bg bbox, recolor template pixels with section-3 color and bg pixels with section-4 color, then repeat the crop once per 4-connected component in section 2 with a section-4-colored separator row/col between copies
grid_shape: horizontal or vertical strip determined by separator orientation
